codes.def: A demonstrated gain in reading (phonics, fluency, vocabulary, comprehension, reading level) or in writing and composition in any genre.
codes.inc: Reading level, fluency, comprehension scores; reading or ELA test proficiency; writing quality, essays, published writing presented as a writing skill.
codes.exc: Confidence or habits about reading or writing; oral presentation; English learners' language acquisition; pre-K pre-literacy.
codes.ui: Y1.12 confidence about reading aloud; Y4.6 public speaking; Y1.2 English learners; Y1.8 pre-K pre-literacy; Y2.5 creative writing as self-expression with no stated skill gain.

codes.def: Growth in English proficiency for English learners (listening, speaking, reading, writing), or maintenance and development of a home language alongside English.
codes.inc: ELP level gains, reclassification, WIDA/ELPAC-type scores; bilingual or home-language maintenance for youth.
codes.exc: A native English speaker learning another language (a world language); adult ESL.
codes.ui: Y1.5 world languages; F1.6 adult English classes; Y5.2 pride in one's language as identity.

codes.def: A demonstrated gain in math skill, problem-solving or grade-level math proficiency.
codes.inc: Math test scores and proficiency; specific math skills; math used in money contexts when the outcome is the math.
codes.exc: Math confidence or growth mindset; grades or GPA in a math class; money-management habits.
codes.ui: Y1.12 math mindset; Y1.15 grades; Y7.6 budgeting and saving.

codes.def: A demonstrated gain in science (life, physical, earth, environmental), engineering design, or computing and coding, including digital-literacy skills.
codes.inc: Science test proficiency; ecosystem or ecology knowledge; engineering design process; coding, computational thinking, digital skills.
codes.exc: STEM interest; STEM identity; online safety; industry certifications; advanced course enrollment.
codes.ui: Y2.2/Y2.3 interest; Y5.3 'a STEM person'; Y6.7 online safety; Y7.4 certifications; Y1.16 enrolling in advanced STEM courses.

codes.def: A demonstrated gain in history, geography, economics, world languages or another academic subject not covered by Y1.1-Y1.4 or Y1.6.
codes.inc: History and geography content; economics concepts; a world language learned by a native English speaker; other ESSA well-rounded subjects.
codes.exc: Civics and government (Y6.2); health education (Y8.3); personal finance (Y7.6); practical skills with no academic content.
codes.ui: Y6.2 civics; Y8.3 health knowledge; Y7.6 financial capability; Y1.7 research and source evaluation.

codes.def: A demonstrated gain in technique, vocabulary or knowledge of an art form (dance, media arts, music, theatre, visual arts).
codes.inc: Instrument proficiency; dance or art vocabulary; juried or assessed artistic skill.
codes.exc: Creating or performing as self-expression or experience, with no stated skill gain.
codes.ui: Y2.5 creative expression and performance; Y2.3 a lasting passion for an art form.

codes.def: Analyzing and evaluating information and sources, research and inquiry skills, and media literacy, in any subject.
codes.inc: Evaluating source credibility; identifying misinformation; research projects framed as inquiry skill; analyzing conflicting sources.
codes.exc: Online privacy and safety; interpersonal problem-solving; analyzing power and injustice.
codes.ui: Y6.7 online safety; Y4.10 personal decision-making; Y6.3 critical consciousness.

codes.def: Early language, literacy, math and cognitive development, and kindergarten readiness, for children below kindergarten age.
codes.inc: Pre-literacy (letter recognition, phonemic awareness); early numeracy; readiness assessments; broad developmental milestones on screeners such as the ASQ.
codes.exc: Early motor skills; developmental screenings received (a service); social-emotional skills of young children.
codes.ui: Y8.2 motor skills; Y8.5 screenings and referrals received; Y4 for social-emotional skills at any age.

codes.def: Observable participation in schoolwork: homework completion, being prepared, class participation.
codes.inc: Homework completion rates; asking questions and taking part in class discussions; coming prepared.
codes.exc: School attendance rates; program attendance; curiosity as a feeling.
codes.ui: Y1.13 school attendance; A2.5 program attendance counts; Y2.2 curiosity.

codes.def: Using specific methods to learn: note-taking, planners, test preparation, self-quizzing, metacognition.
codes.inc: Named study techniques; planning schoolwork with a tool.
codes.exc: General organization outside school; goal-setting in general.

codes.def: Beliefs about oneself as a learner: academic self-efficacy, belonging in academic work, and growth mindset about intelligence or ability to learn.
codes.inc: 'I can succeed in this class'; believing intelligence or math ability grows with effort; confidence in academic abilities.
codes.exc: General self-confidence; growth mindset about challenges in general.
codes.ui: Y5.4 general confidence and general growth mindset. CP-01-06 (in flight) sets the same line for 2.4.0.

codes.def: A student's school attendance, chronic absence, or staying enrolled in school through disruption (homelessness, foster placement changes, pregnancy).
codes.inc: Attendance rates for participating students; chronic absenteeism; remaining enrolled or in the school of origin.
codes.exc: Program attendance or dosage; re-enrolling after dropping out.
codes.ui: A2.5 program attendance; Y1.17 re-engagement after leaving school.

codes.def: Suspensions, expulsions, office discipline referrals, and alternatives that replace them.
codes.inc: Fewer suspensions or referrals; restorative alternatives to suspension; school-level suspension rates.
codes.exc: Reduced fighting or violence; interpersonal conflict resolution skills.
codes.ui: Y8.12 fights and violence; Y4.8 conflict resolution skill.

codes.def: Course grades, GPA, course passing, credit accumulation, promotion, 9th-grade on-track status, and 'academic performance' or test scores with no subject named.
codes.inc: GPA; passing core classes; credits for promotion; unspecified academic achievement.
codes.exc: A test score in a named subject; graduation; attendance.
codes.ui: The subject code (Y1.1-Y1.6) for a named-subject test; Y1.17 graduation; Y1.13 attendance.

codes.def: Enrolling in or completing advanced courses: AP, IB, honors, advanced STEM electives, dual enrollment and college credit earned in high school.
codes.inc: AP/IB/honors enrollment; dual enrollment; college credit before graduation.
codes.exc: Interest in a subject; postsecondary enrollment after high school.
codes.ui: Y2.3 lasting interest; Y1.18 college enrollment.

codes.def: Graduating from high school, earning a GED or equivalency, or re-enrolling after leaving school.
codes.inc: On-time graduation; GED; re-engagement after dropout or release.
codes.exc: Adult GED (caregivers); staying enrolled through disruption.
codes.ui: F1.6 adult education; Y1.13 school stability.

codes.def: Enrolling in, persisting in, or completing college or other postsecondary education or training after high school.
codes.inc: College enrollment the fall after graduation; first-to-second-year persistence; degree or certificate completion.
codes.exc: Applications and FAFSA (the process); college credit in high school; combined 'employed or in education' indicators.
codes.ui: Y7.2 applications and FAFSA; Y1.16 dual credit; Y7.5 for WIOA-style combined indicators.

codes.def: A positive emotional experience of the program or of learning: fun, happiness, excitement, pride in being part of it.
codes.inc: Reports of enjoying activities; excitement to attend; pride in the program.
codes.exc: General life satisfaction or flourishing; feeling safe or accepted.

codes.def: Interest sparked in the moment: curiosity, asking questions about something new, willingness to try a new activity.
codes.inc: Asking questions during a demonstration; trying new activities; showing curiosity.
codes.exc: Interest that lasts or is pursued beyond the program; general confidence to take on challenges.

codes.def: Interest that persists, deepens or becomes the young person's own: a passion, returning to a topic, pursuing it beyond the program.
codes.inc: Discovering a passion; continuing an activity after the program; self-directed pursuit of a topic.
codes.exc: Momentary curiosity; interest in a career field; identity ('I am a ___ person').
codes.ui: Y2.2 curiosity; Y7.1 career interest; Y5.3 domain identity.

codes.def: Seeing learning as useful for one's goals, future plans or community.
codes.inc: Explaining how a subject connects to careers or daily life; valuing what is learned.
codes.exc: Career awareness; general purpose in life.

codes.def: Self-expression through making something (art, music, writing, design), presenting or performing finished work, or responding to art, as an experience rather than a stated skill gain.
codes.inc: Composing, creating, exhibiting, performing, critiquing or connecting art to personal meaning.
codes.exc: A stated technique or knowledge gain in an art form; a stated writing skill gain; teamwork during a production.
codes.ui: Y1.6 arts skill; Y1.1 writing skill; Y4.7 collaboration.

codes.def: An individual young person's choice to take part in constructive activities, inside the program (returning, joining) or outside it (sports, arts, clubs, faith groups).
codes.inc: Returning for another year; joining a team or club; participating fully alongside peers; per-person participation thresholds.
codes.exc: Aggregate program attendance, counts or rates; the program's accommodations.

codes.def: Feeling accepted, valued, included and safe in the program, school or a community; mattering; less isolation.
codes.inc: Sense of belonging; feeling safe and accepted in program spaces; feeling connected to a new community; reduced loneliness.
codes.exc: Feeling safe in general (home, neighborhood); trauma-related safety; one named trusted adult; named friendships.
codes.ui: Y8.10 general felt safety; Y8.8 trauma recovery; Y3.2 a trusted adult; Y3.3 friends. Follows the safety tie-breaker being tested in PR #31.

codes.def: A caring, trusting relationship with at least one adult outside the family (mentor, staff, teacher, coach), including its quality (care, challenge, support).
codes.inc: Naming a trusted adult; a mentor who cares or challenges; permanent adult connections for youth in care.
codes.exc: A wider network used to open opportunities; family relationships.

codes.def: Friendships, peer acceptance and a positive peer group.
codes.inc: Making friends; a supportive peer community; friendships across groups.
codes.exc: The skill of working together; general belonging to the program.

codes.def: The young person's own relationship with their family: communication, connection, repair, reunification.
codes.inc: Reunification; rebuilding trust with family; better communication with parents as described from the youth side.
codes.exc: Parenting practices (the parent is the subject); housing.
codes.ui: F1.1 when parents are the subject ('parents will communicate better with their children'); F2.3 housing.

codes.def: Access to, and use of, a wider network of relationships (adults, peers, professionals, employers) that can open educational or career opportunities.
codes.inc: Expanding a professional network; introductions and references; contacts who can help with a goal.
codes.exc: One trusted adult; friends.

codes.def: Recognizing and naming one's own emotions.
codes.inc: Identifying feelings; using a feelings chart; naming emotions in hard moments.
codes.exc: Managing emotions; understanding others' feelings.
codes.ui: Y4.2 regulation; Y4.4 empathy; Y5.1 identity and Y5.4 self-efficacy or growth mindset (CASEL self-awareness items that sit in Y5, FD-P10, FD-P11).

codes.def: Managing strong emotions and impulses, and using coping strategies for stress, worry or frustration.
codes.inc: Calming down; frustration tolerance; self-regulation; deep breathing or journaling to manage stress.
codes.exc: Reduced symptoms of anxiety or depression; caregiver stress; academic persistence.
codes.ui: Y8.6 symptoms; F1.4 caregiver stress; Y1.10 academic perseverance.

codes.def: Setting personal goals and working toward them, and general organization, self-discipline and persistence outside schoolwork.
codes.inc: Setting and pursuing goals; completing projects; keeping materials organized; follow-through.
codes.exc: Study techniques; persistence with schoolwork; career plans.
codes.ui: Y1.11 study strategies; Y1.10 academic perseverance; Y7.1 career exploration.

codes.def: Understanding and caring about others' feelings and perspectives, expressing gratitude, and reading social norms and expectations in different settings.
codes.inc: Perspective-taking; compassion; gratitude; understanding expectations in class, online and community settings.
codes.exc: Respect for people of other backgrounds; listening as a behavior.
codes.ui: Y4.5 respect for diversity; Y4.6 communication.

codes.def: Respecting and including people of different backgrounds and identities, and examining one's own biases.
codes.inc: Respect for peers of other cultures, religions, abilities; inclusive behavior; bias awareness.
codes.exc: Pride in one's own identity; friendships across groups.

codes.def: Expressing oneself clearly, listening actively, and speaking to an audience.
codes.inc: Active listening; clear communication; presentations and public speaking.
codes.exc: Workplace communication; written composition; confidence about speaking in class.
codes.ui: Y7.3 workplace; Y1.1 writing; Y1.12 academic confidence.

codes.def: Working with others toward shared goals, including leading peers within a group task.
codes.inc: Collaboration on projects; teamwork; taking turns leading a small group; leadership within a team activity.
codes.exc: Leadership that influences a program, school or community decision; friendships; workplace leadership.
codes.ui: Y6.4 civic leadership; Y3.3 friendships; Y7.3 workplace. Same line as CP-01-06's leadership rule (in flight).

codes.def: Building, maintaining and repairing relationships, and resolving interpersonal conflict constructively.
codes.inc: Resolving disagreements without fighting; de-escalation; repairing a friendship.
codes.exc: Reduced incidence of fights; exclusionary discipline; the relationship outcome itself.
codes.ui: Y8.12 fights; Y1.14 discipline; Y3.3/Y3.4 relationships.

codes.def: Knowing where to find support, asking for help, and offering help to others.
codes.inc: Willingness to seek help; naming resources to contact in a crisis; helping peers.
codes.exc: Actually receiving mental health services; self-advocacy for accommodations.

codes.def: Weighing options and consequences and working a personal or social problem through from identifying it to acting.
codes.inc: Pros and cons before a decision; structured problem-solving; anticipating consequences.
codes.exc: Interpersonal conflict; academic analysis of sources; ethical choices.
codes.ui: Y4.8 conflict; Y1.7 critical thinking; Y4.11 ethical choices.

codes.def: Making an ethical or prosocial choice in a specific situation, including small daily contributions to the class or program.
codes.inc: Reporting bullying instead of joining in; standing up for a classmate; helping clean up the space.
codes.exc: General character traits; challenging systems of injustice; organized community service.
codes.ui: Y6.1 values; Y6.3 critical consciousness; Y6.5 service.

codes.def: Avoiding unsafe situations and resisting negative peer pressure.
codes.inc: Refusal skills; leaving unsafe situations; resisting pressure to use substances.
codes.exc: An actual change in substance use or violence; safety knowledge such as first aid.
codes.ui: Y8.11/Y8.12 for incidence; Y8.3 safety knowledge.

codes.def: Understanding who one is, what matters to one, and how one is changing.
codes.inc: Identity exploration; articulating one's values and experiences.
codes.exc: Pride in a cultural or social identity; self-confidence; purpose.

codes.def: Pride in, and acceptance of, one's own cultural, ethnic, linguistic, gender, sexual or other social identity.
codes.inc: Pride in heritage; self-acceptance of sexual orientation or gender identity; bicultural identity.
codes.exc: Respect for others' identities; home-language skill.

codes.def: Seeing oneself as a certain kind of person in a field: 'a STEM person', an artist, an athlete, a reader, a writer.
codes.inc: 'See themselves as' statements tied to a field.
codes.exc: Loving an activity; career interest.
codes.ui: Y2.3 'I love doing ___'; Y7.1 career interest.

codes.def: A general belief that one can succeed and handle challenges, including general growth mindset and self-esteem.
codes.inc: Self-confidence; self-efficacy; self-esteem; naming one's strengths; growth mindset about setbacks.
codes.exc: Confidence about schoolwork; confidence in a named physical skill where the skill is the outcome.
codes.ui: Y1.12 academic mindsets; Y8.2 when the physical skill gain is the point.

codes.def: A sense of purpose and meaning, optimism about the future, and aspirations, including spiritual purpose and growth in faith.
codes.inc: Sense of purpose; hopes and goals for life; growth in faith or spiritual life.
codes.exc: Faith-grounded values (Y6.1); belonging to a faith community (Y3.1); career aspirations (Y7.1).

codes.def: Acting as the causal agent in one's own life: making choices, advocating for one's own needs, directing one's own supports.
codes.inc: Self-advocacy in IEP meetings; leading one's own IEP; requesting accommodations; making and explaining one's own choices.
codes.exc: Influencing collective decisions; asking for help in general.

codes.def: General character traits and guiding values: integrity, honesty, responsibility, sportsmanship, forgiveness, faith-grounded values.
codes.inc: Honesty; responsibility; sportsmanship; living out values, including faith-based values.
codes.exc: A choice in one specific situation; faith growth or spiritual purpose.
codes.ui: Y4.11 situational choices; Y5.5 faith growth.

codes.def: Understanding how government, civic institutions, elections and rights work.
codes.inc: How a bill becomes law; branches of government; how the school board decides; voter registration process.
codes.exc: Families learning to navigate school or benefit systems; history content.

codes.def: Analyzing power, inequity and systems of oppression, and acting against injustice.
codes.inc: Analyzing why food deserts or zoning inequality exist; articulating how systemic racism affects a community.
codes.exc: Standing up for a classmate in one situation; respect for diversity.

codes.def: Influencing collective decisions and taking part in civic life: youth councils, testimony, advocacy, co-design, organizing, voting, and civic efficacy.
codes.inc: Presenting to a city council; youth advisory boards; organizing campaigns; registering and voting; believing one can influence community decisions.
codes.exc: Leading peers within a group task; one's own IEP or personal choices.

codes.def: Organized service or projects to improve the community, including identifying a community issue and planning action on it.
codes.inc: Service hours; service trips; food drives; community action plans.
codes.exc: Small daily help in the program; environmental action; civic advocacy aimed at decision-makers.

codes.def: Caring for the environment and acting on it: pro-environmental behavior and connection to nature.
codes.inc: Recycling and composting; reducing waste; stewardship; connection to nature.
codes.exc: Knowledge of ecosystems; feeling restored in nature.

codes.def: Safe, legal and ethical behavior online: privacy, security, recognizing scams, respectful conduct.
codes.inc: Protecting personal information; strong passwords; recognizing phishing.
codes.exc: Evaluating news credibility; coding skills; device access.

codes.def: Learning about careers and pathways, interest inventories, workplace and campus visits, and interest in or aspiration toward a career field.
codes.inc: Researching careers; exploring pathways; interest in a STEM career; college visits.
codes.exc: Applications and FAFSA; lasting interest in an activity.

codes.def: Knowing and completing the process of moving to college or work: applications, FAFSA, financial aid, resumes, interviews.
codes.inc: FAFSA completion; college applications; comparing aid letters; resume writing.
codes.exc: Enrolment itself; employability behaviors on the job.

codes.def: Professionalism and workplace skills: punctuality, workplace communication, initiative, job performance.
codes.inc: Professional conduct; supervisor evaluations; workplace communication.
codes.exc: Having or keeping a job; general SEL skills outside a work context.

codes.def: Industry-specific skills, recognized credentials and certifications, and completing internships or apprenticeships.
codes.inc: Industry certifications; apprenticeship completion; trade skills.
codes.exc: Employment after training; academic computing skills.

codes.def: Getting or keeping a job, wages and earnings, and combined 'employed or in education' indicators.
codes.inc: Job placement; paid work hours; wages; competitive integrated employment; WIOA-style combined indicators.
codes.exc: Training completion; household income.

codes.def: The young person's own financial knowledge, habits and decisions: budgeting, saving, banking, credit, understanding pay and taxes.
codes.inc: Budgets; savings accounts; reading a pay stub; understanding credit and interest.
codes.exc: Household income or benefits; the youth's wages; arithmetic with money as context.

codes.def: Daily living skills for self-sufficiency: cooking, scheduling, transportation, self-care away from home, and obtaining vital documents.
codes.inc: Independent-living skill bundles; getting an ID, Social Security card and birth certificate; self-care at camp.
codes.exc: Money-only skills; own housing.

codes.def: Everyday health behaviors: physical activity and fitness, nutrition and healthy eating, sleep, hygiene, and recreational screen time.
codes.inc: Minutes of activity; fitness; fruit and vegetable intake; healthy cooking framed as nutrition; hours of sleep; handwashing; less screen time.
codes.exc: Sport or motor skill gains; health care visits; first aid; household food access.

codes.def: Fundamental movement, fine and gross motor, and sport-specific or outdoor physical skills.
codes.inc: Dribbling and passing; swimming levels; running, jumping, throwing; fine motor skills; hiking or climbing technique.
codes.exc: Fitness or activity minutes; confidence in general.

codes.def: Health information and safety skills not covered by another health code: first aid, injury prevention, finding reliable health information, and health education content.
codes.inc: First aid; outdoor safety; health class content; how to respond to an allergic reaction.
codes.exc: Sexual health knowledge; substance-risk knowledge; industry safety credentials.

codes.def: Knowledge and behavior related to sexual health, STI and pregnancy prevention, and healthy relationships in that context.
codes.inc: STI prevention knowledge; delaying pregnancy; accessing confidential services.
codes.exc: Dating violence as violence; parenting.

codes.def: Getting and using health care: insurance, preventive and dental or vision visits, screenings, immunizations, and managing chronic conditions.
codes.inc: Enrolling in insurance; annual screenings; developmental screenings received; asthma self-management.
codes.exc: Mental health services; parents keeping infants' well-child visits.

codes.def: Fewer symptoms of anxiety, depression, distress or behavioral problems in the young person.
codes.inc: Lower anxiety or depression scores; fewer outbursts; less self-reported stress.
codes.exc: Coping skills; caregiver stress; loneliness framed socially.

codes.def: Positive mental health: life satisfaction, flourishing, feeling restored or well.
codes.inc: Life satisfaction; flourishing; general well-being.
codes.exc: Enjoying the program; symptom reduction.

codes.def: A young person processing trauma, feeling psychologically safe during recovery, and moving toward healing.
codes.inc: Processing traumatic events; psychological safety for trauma-exposed youth.
codes.exc: Staff adopting trauma-informed practice; general felt safety.

codes.def: Being connected to and using counseling, therapy or crisis services.
codes.inc: Referrals completed; sessions attended; connection to community providers.
codes.exc: Knowing where to get help (a skill); staff training on referrals.

codes.def: Feeling safe at home, at school or in the neighborhood, not specific to the program.
codes.inc: Feeling safe walking to school or in the neighborhood.
codes.exc: Safety and acceptance in the program; trauma-related safety; safe choices; reduced victimization.
codes.ui: Y3.1; Y8.8; Y4.12; Y8.12. Mirrors CP-01-07's tie-breaker (PR #31, in flight).

codes.def: Use, intentions or perceived risk of tobacco, vaping, alcohol or other drugs.
codes.inc: Reduced use; delayed first use; lower intentions; higher perceived risk; knowledge of risks.
codes.exc: Refusal skills; policy restricting access.

codes.def: Fighting, weapon carrying, bullying, harassment, dating violence and community violence, as perpetrator or victim.
codes.inc: Fewer fights; less weapon carrying; less harassment; dating-violence warning signs.
codes.exc: Suspensions; conflict-resolution skill.

codes.def: Avoiding justice-system involvement, completing diversion or probation, and reduced recidivism.
codes.inc: No new adjudication; completing a restorative agreement; avoiding re-arrest.
codes.exc: Re-enrolling in school or getting a job after release.

codes.def: Caregivers' child-development knowledge, parenting practices, parent-child interaction and parenting confidence, including teen parents.
codes.inc: Knowledge of milestones; positive discipline; positive interactions; parenting confidence.
codes.exc: Home learning routines; family health practices; the youth's side of the relationship.

codes.def: Family practices that support a child's learning and development at home: reading together, routines, homework time.
codes.inc: Reading at home; bedtime and daily routines; homework space.
codes.exc: Parenting knowledge in general.

codes.def: Caregiver or household health practices for children: breastfeeding, safe sleep, well-child visits kept by the parent, family eating habits.
codes.inc: Breastfeeding; safe sleep; well-child visits; family fruit and vegetable intake.
codes.exc: Household food access; the youth's own health care.

codes.def: The caregiver's own stress, mental health and resilience.
codes.inc: Reduced parenting stress; lower caregiver depression; resilience.
codes.exc: The child's mental health; adult learners' tech anxiety about a skill.

codes.def: Caregivers building supportive relationships with other parents or their community.
codes.inc: Parent friendships; peer support groups.
codes.exc: The family's relationship with the program.

codes.def: The education, training, English proficiency, digital or financial skills, and employment of a caregiver or other adult participant.
codes.inc: GED or job training for parents; adult ESL; digital literacy for family members or older adults.
codes.exc: Household income; young people's own skills.

codes.def: Families knowing their rights, knowing where to turn for help, navigating school or service systems, and getting connected to resources.
codes.inc: IDEA rights knowledge; understanding enrollment and health systems; connecting to resources; knowing where to turn in a crisis.
codes.exc: Receiving benefits; civic knowledge of government.

codes.n: Family Connection & Trust with the Program
codes.def: The family's relationship with and trust in the program or school, and communication between them.
codes.inc: Families feeling welcome; trust in staff; feeling connected to the school community.
codes.exc: Parents' confidence in program safety or satisfaction; family participation in events or decisions.

codes.def: Families attending, volunteering or taking part in program or school decisions.
codes.inc: Serving on advisory councils; attending workshops (per-family thresholds); volunteering.
codes.exc: Aggregate family attendance counts; the organization creating structures.

codes.def: Household or independent-youth income, public benefits, and financial stability.
codes.inc: Household income; SNAP/TANF/Medicaid enrollment; household savings.
codes.exc: The youth's own money skills; caregiver job training.

codes.def: Having enough food and access to healthy food.
codes.inc: Reduced food insecurity; fewer skipped meals; less reliance on emergency food.
codes.exc: Household eating practices; food distribution counts.

codes.def: Securing or keeping safe, stable housing, for a household or a young person living independently.
codes.inc: Exits to stable housing; avoiding eviction; keeping a lease; reduced rent burden.
codes.exc: Services delivered toward housing; school stability.

codes.def: Staff, volunteers, mentors, coaches or case managers gaining knowledge or skills.
codes.inc: Training outcomes; staff confidence; volunteers' understanding.
codes.exc: Training hours completed (an output); applying the learning.

codes.def: Adults applying new practices, including trauma-informed care.
codes.inc: Implementing a curriculum or screener; adopting restorative or trauma-informed practice.
codes.exc: Program quality scores; learning only.

codes.def: Staff retention and turnover, and staff well-being.
codes.inc: Turnover rates; retention; burnout.
codes.exc: Staff learning.

codes.def: Observed or assessed program quality (safe, supportive, interactive, engaging environment) and accreditation.
codes.inc: YPQA or similar scores; accreditation; a more welcoming or affirming environment.
codes.exc: Participants' satisfaction; staff practice change.

codes.def: Participants' or families' satisfaction with the program and their perceptions of its quality and safety.
codes.inc: Satisfaction ratings; parents' confidence in program safety.
codes.exc: Youth enjoyment; family trust in staff.

codes.def: Providing materials, devices, connectivity or facilities, including counts of resources distributed.
codes.inc: Laptops and hotspots; home internet; facilities access.
codes.exc: Participants' digital skills.

codes.def: Removing barriers so that all participants can take part: accommodations, accessible formats, interpretation and translation.
codes.inc: Sensory kits and visual schedules; accessible materials; interpreters; home-language communications.
codes.exc: Youth participating alongside peers (their participation); families navigating systems.

codes.def: Program-level counts, rates and dosage: youth served, attendance rates, sessions, match length, training hours, and services staff delivered.
codes.inc: Number served; average daily attendance; match duration; sessions delivered; applications submitted by staff.
codes.exc: An individual youth's choice to return; a student's school attendance.

codes.def: The organization's systems, events or policies for engaging families.
codes.inc: Creating a parent advisory council; family engagement policies; family events offered.
codes.exc: Parents serving on the council; interpretation services.

codes.def: Changes to policy, funding or institutional practice in schools, districts, cities or states.
codes.inc: New ordinances; district policies; dedicated budget funding.
codes.exc: Partnerships and data sharing; program quality.

codes.def: Shared agendas, shared measurement and coordinated partnerships across organizations and sectors.
codes.inc: Data-sharing agreements; shared data systems; coalition collaboration.
codes.exc: Policy adoption.

codes.def: Neighborhood cohesion, trust and willingness to act for the common good.
codes.inc: Residents' trust; willingness to intervene for youth safety.
codes.exc: Individual youth's felt safety.
